The foundational architecture of the GSE engine relies on decoupling signal from noise across three distinct mathematical domains: information theory, spectral graph theory, and robust statistics. First, we address the fundamental danger of double-counting in sports betting. The market line ($X_1$) inherently prices in public consensus. Our situational reasoning ($X_2$) must provide strictly orthogonal alpha. Using Partial Information Decomposition (PID), we rigorously partition the mutual information $I(X_1, X_2; Y)$ into redundancy ($R$), unique information ($U_1, U_2$), and synergy ($S$). The engine explicitly calculates and subtracts $R$, ensuring our calibration maps only shift log-odds based on $U_2 + S$. This prevents the model from simply echoing the closing line value (CLV). Second, modeling the 22-player on-field interaction requires navigating the 'over-smoothing' plague of deep Graph Neural Networks (GNNs). If we propagate features too deeply across WR-CB or OL-DL edges, distinct player identities blur into a uniform average. We introduce a Dirichlet energy lower-bound constraint, $E_{\text{Dir}}(\mathbf{X})$, which penalizes excessive smoothness across the normalized Laplacian $\tilde{\mathbf{L}}$, preserving the sharp tactical boundaries required for accurate matchup projection. Third, traditional covariance-based DFS optimizers fail because they assume Gaussian symmetry, missing the massive positive co-skewness inherent in shootout scripts (e.g., QB-WR1-WR2 explosions). Standard PCA suffers from rotational ambiguity, mixing distinct offensive scripts. By deploying Jennrich's 3rd-order tensor decomposition on our simulated worlds, we isolate these asymmetric upside clusters. Finally, to feed these models clean data, we bypass naive rolling averages. We apply a two-step robust filter: Yeo-Johnson transformation followed by Minimum Covariance Determinant (MCD) Mahalanobis distance calculation. Any observation where fantasy points spike but underlying usage metrics (Snap%, WOPR) do not is flagged as a statistical fluke and Winsorized. This multi-layered mathematical defense ensures the GSE engine operates purely on structural, unpriced inefficiencies.
